policy: Official DEFAULT Hey Willow returns, existing handoff fixed-v5 clocks, same two unprompted GPU readers and same two decoded Opus time windows. Unopened cases count against end-to-end completeness. Piper uses four Willow cue voices on each of the same eighteen command clips and one handoff Nyx cue on each. Kokoro uses twelve name-specific whole-sentence syntheses per route at matched voice, text and speed. The two address syntheses can have different command waveforms.
